To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Mithril, an algorithm that exploits historical patterns in block-storage cache request associations, gives an average of 55% hit-ratio increase over LRU, and 36% over Amp, with reasonable cost, and that the improvement comes from the ability to capture mid-frequency requests.

(1) we propose Mithril to mine sporadic associations for block storage cache prefetching and demonstrate its efficacy, (2) Mithril is the first approach that can mine sporadic associations and is effective, (3) we evaluate Mithril on 135 traces, and (4) we show that MITHRIL is effective, giving a 55% increase in hit ratio over LRU and a 36 % gain over Amp at a reasonable cost.
Mithril can improve cache performance in block storage systems by 36% at reasonable cost, and this improvement is due to Mithril being effective at mid-frequency blocks.
